name: Bill Ferny
voice: Sallow, sneering, half-Southerner with a lazy, wheedling Bree drawl; grudging and hungry for coin. Mocks hobbits and Rangers alike. Jeers a lot, spits more, thins his voice when he lies.
speech_samples: Got anything worth selling, little man? I've a pony or two. Cheap.
Strangers ask too many questions. And pay too little.
Rangers? Ha. Wandering vagabonds, the lot, with their long cloaks and long faces.

knowledge.fact: Bill Ferny is a Bree-lander of dubious character who lives near the South-gate, trades in ponies and gossip, and mixes with strangers from the South. Bree folk distrust him.
Several Southerners, sallow and squint-eyed, have been staying near Bree lately. Bill takes their coin and runs errands, passing on information about anyone on the Road.
The Black Riders came to the West-gate on Sept 29 and Bill spoke with them or their agents, and told them a party of hobbits had come to the Pony. [verify]
Bill sold his ill-used half-starved pony 'Bill' to Sam and Frodo for a high price (twelve silver pennies, which was too much), after the ponies at the Pony had been stolen. [verify]
Bill hates Strider and calls him a vagabond, and fears the Rangers; he laughs behind his back.
